Today I worked on onboarding:

1. I sent a text message to Kaisen asking him to hop on a call to see if we are going to continue and launch into his other stores, and if he is going to renew.
2. I am working on my Shopify. I redid all the Shopify images and I am currently working on the onboarding flow so that when someone finds it organically, they go through the flow and convert into a paying customer.
3. I sent two DMs.
4. I got a list of 200 clothing stores that I will use tomorrow.

My bottleneck today was time because I had school.
